Chapter 350 - 350 Constitution Enhancement; Let'S Go Home!

Chapter 350 - 350 Constitution Enhancement; Let's Go Home!

350 Constitution Enhancement; Let’s Go Home!

Now, the cooperation was successful, and he had even received two golden packets.

Everyone from the Sun family and the Liu family, as well as Lin Fan, were in a good mood. The atmosphere of the banquet became even more lively.

When Lin Fan returned to the Coiling Dragon Villa, it was already two hours later.

He sat on the soft sofa and played with his phone for a while.

After a while, he turned his attention to the golden packets.

“Let’s see what I can get,” Lin Fan muttered.

“Open!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 800,000 yuan.]

[Ding! [Congratulations, you’ve received a Constitution Enhancement Potion.]

Seeing this, Lin Fan’s eyes lit up.

Not long ago, he had obtained a bottle of Constitution Enhancement Potion. After drinking it, his strength, speed, and other aspects had obviously increased greatly.

This was definitely something good.

He did not expect to obtain another bottle so quickly.

When Lin Fan raised his head, he saw a bottle of transparent liquid on the coffee table.

This… It was the Constitution Enhancement Potion that he had just obtained.

Without any hesitation, Lin Fan downed it.

Similar to the last time, it was as if a warm current had flowed through his heart.

At the same time, his entire body was filled with endless power.

Lin Fan jumped up lightly. His entire body seemed to have lost all gravity as he flew toward the ceiling.

Luckily, Lin Fan reacted quickly and blocked it with his hand.

Otherwise, his head would have made contact with the ceiling.

One had to know…

The height of the Coiling Dragon Villa was more than five meters. In other words, Lin Fan easily jumped over five meters!

With the 100% Hidden Weapon Skill and his current strength, the dart instantly passed through the bullseye and completely sank into the wall.

Simply… terrifying!

Even Lin Fan was stunned.

‘Am I that strong now?’

…

While Lin Fan was in a daze, in the female dormitory of Jiangbei University.

Zhao Ni took a bottle of iced Coke and strode in. She saw Xia Bing and Xia Xue reading on the table.

“Studying again?”

In fact, she was just asking casually.

However, in the next moment, Zhao Ni’s tone changed slightly as she said in surprise, “Huh? This is bio… medicine? When did you start researching this?”

One had to know…

During this period of time, Xia Bing and Xia Xue, the two computer geniuses, had been studying chemistry hard every day.

This already made Zhao Ni very puzzled.

It took her a long time to slowly accept this.

Now, they had changed their focus to biomedicine?

Xia Bing and Xia Xue nodded gently and said softly, “Yes… That’s right.”

Zhao Ni looked at it for a while before rubbing her head. “After learning computer science, you learned chemistry. Now, it’s biology… Is this the world of top students?”

She shook her head and walked toward the bathroom.

Xia Bing and Xia Xue slowly turned their attention to the paper in Nature titled Principles of Human Islet Recovery Medicine.

After that, they focused even more on biomedicine.

…

In the blink of an eye, it was the weekend.

Today, the sun was shining brightly, and there was a gentle breeze.

Lin Fan drove the Cullinan toward Qing City.

Back then, when Lin Fan was still at work, no matter how busy he was, he would take the time to visit his parents and sister.

Now that he was just at school, he had to go home more often.

About an hour later, he arrived at the front of Fourth Street.

Lin Fan had just parked his car when he heard Lin Xiaoyao’s crisp voice not far away.

“Brother!”

Then, Lin Xiaoyao jogged and pounced on him.

Lin Fan said, “You’ve gotten lighter again. Your face has become smaller. It’s full of bones when I pinch it. Hurry up and eat more!”

“Brother!” Lin Xiaoyao said angrily.

Lin Tao, who was beside them, smiled. “Alright, go in. Your mother should have prepared dinner.”

Sure enough, just as he said, the meal was ready.

Shredded pork with green pepper, chicken soup, glutinous rice fish, hot and sour shredded potatoes, sweet and sour pork ribs, cucumber ham, tomato scrambled eggs… Six dishes and a soup filled the table. The appearance, fragrance, and taste were all perfect, making one’s appetite rise.

The family sat around the table. The atmosphere was warm and comfortable.

Everyone was very satisfied.

After a full meal, the family sat in front of the television, eating melon seeds and chatting.

“When I went to pick Lil Yao up from school, I saw two kids from her school dating. I was sure to criticize them,” Lin Tao said.

“Lil Yao, you can’t date in school,” Dai Weixue immediately said.

“I won’t fall in love. Those little boys in school are too childish,” Lin Xiaoyao said.

“Lil Yao can’t date, but you can, Lil Fan.” Lin Tao nodded.

“That’s right! Lil Fan, you should get a girlfriend when you have time. Don’t just focus on your studies. There are fewer and fewer women nowadays. If you don’t find one now, you might not be able to find one in the future,” Dai Weixue followed up with a look of anticipation.

Lin Xiaoyao said, “Dad, Mom, I think… There’s no need to worry about Brother dating! He might even have a few girlfriends already.”

She knew that Lin Fan owned a lot of villas and sports cars. He had a big house full of Gucci items and was a major shareholder of Cha Yue. In addition, Lin Fan was tall and handsome. How could he not get a girlfriend?

Not to mention other things, her two female classmates were in love with Lin Fan.

“Cough, cough, cough!”

When Lin Fan heard Lin Xiaoyao’s words, he almost choked.

Dai Weixue’s eyes lit up as she asked, “Really? Lil Fan, when are you going to bring your girlfriend back for us to see?”

Lin Tao, who had been sipping his tea, put down his cup and looked at Lin Fan.

Lin Fan was being stared at by his parents, so he could only bite the bullet and say, “This… I… I’ll look for another chance.”

What should he do?

Who should he bring back?

Qin Yuxuan?

Qiu Ziqian?

Hu Tian?

…

He could not bring them all back, right?

“Alright, haha!” Lin Tao said happily.

Dai Weixue asked, “Do you have a photo of your girlfriend?”

“I didn’t take any photos with my phone,” Lin Fan said.

Lin Fan was not lying. He really had not used his phone to take any photos.

Of course, even if he had, Lin Fan would not show them any photos for the time being.

At this moment, Lin Xiaoyao seemed to have thought of something and said in a timid tone, “Brother, if your girlfriend finds out that you just drank the Coke I bought, she won’t scold me, right?

“Your girlfriend won’t hit me if she knows that I jumped into your arms, right?

“Brother, if your girlfriend is so scary… my heart will only ache for you.”

After saying that, she even pretended to be trembling.

Dai Weixue said, “You have to be careful in case Lil Fan’s girlfriend gets the wrong idea in the future.”

“You do have to be careful,” Lin Tao added.

Lin Fan smiled. “Dad, Mom, don’t listen to Lil Yao’s nonsense. She learned this joke from the internet.”
